item.coloph: ces 'chi med tshe yi bsgrubs (sgrub) pa/ tshe sgrub dmu yad 'khyil ba zhes bya ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bcud/ phyi rabs 'gro ba tshe nyams dang / bsgrubs (sgrub) pa'i gshen po'i don ched du/ bla chen dran pa bdag nyid kyang / nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la gser srang gang gis mchod pa phul nas yang nas yang du bskul ma byas/ skal (dka') ba du ma spyad nas zhus/ stang chen dmu tsha khyod la gtad/ phyi rab (rabs) dus kyi tha ma la/ las ldan skyes bu gcig la sprod/ ces gsungs nas gnyer gtad do/ tshe bsgrubs (sgrub) gsang ba'i cha lag zhes (ces) bya ba/ stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa'i dge legs 'phel//
